text: In the admin portal, Cprime teams can create a course
from a learning objective or import an existing curriculum.
Here, we ask for an intermediate course on cloud architecture.
Ctrl+Teach generates the structure, outcomes, lessons, assessments, and practical activities.
An administrator can review the outline, edit any lesson, inspect the sources, and make changes.
After review, one click publishes the course to the learner catalogue.
On the learner side, onboarding captures their current role and experience,
This learner is an intermediate software engineer who wants to become a cloud architect
Ctrl+Teach first checks for a suitable published roadmap.
Here, it finds the existing Cloud Architect path and recommends it immediately.
The roadmap organizes cloud foundations, networking, automation,
reliability, and security into a clear learning sequence.
Selecting Cloud Foundations brings together the published Cprime course,
the relevant bootcamp, and a personalized generation option.
The learner can start with Cprime content or generate a course
when the available material does not fit their exact level, goal, or time.
